Issue #440: Missing newline after inline table
Repository: python-poetry/tomlkit

Hello,
Sorry to be opening another issue so early after the last one, but I found something else:

```python
v = tomlkit.loads("""[x]\na.b = {}""")
v["x"]["c"] = 3
print(tomlkit.dumps(v))
```

output:
```toml
[x]
a.b = {}c = 3
```

As you can see, there should be a new line before `c = 3`

Note that this doesn't happens with either:
- `"""[x]\na.b = {}\n"""`
- `"""[x]\na = {}"""`

The test file will be saved as tests/test_reprobot_tomlkit__440.py.

import tomlkit

def test_inline_table_newline_after_add():
    v = tomlkit.loads("""[x]\na.b = {}""")
    v["x"]["c"] = 3
    expected = """[x]\na.b = {}\nc = 3\n"""
    assert tomlkit.dumps(v) == expected
